blocks.text: Kisi body (jism) ki energy us ki work karne ki capacity (salahiyat, taaqat) hai. Energy ki do basic (bunyadi) qismein hain:

blocks.title: Kinetic aur potential energy
blocks.text: Kinetic energy woh energy hai jo body ke paas us ki motion (harkat) ki wajah se hoti hai, aur potential energy woh energy hai jo body ke paas us ki badli hui position (jagah) ki wajah se hoti hai.
Kinetic energy aur potential energy dono mechanical energy ki qismein hain.
